mapper.select: SELECT menu_code, menu_name, menu_url, menu_group, sort_order FROM tb_menu ORDER BY menu_group, sort_order
SELECT menu_code FROM tb_user_permission WHERE user_code = #{user_code}

SELECT m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_url, m.menu_group, m.sort_order, CASE WHEN p.menu_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS granted_yn FROM tb_menu m LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_user_permission p ON p.menu_code = m.menu_code AND p.user_code = #{user_code} WHERE m.menu_group NOT IN ('공통로', '전체') ORDER BY m.menu_group, m.sort_order
